description: This PHP script is a component of TestLink, an open-source test management tool. Its primary purpose is to generate direct links to test cases, requirements, requirement specifications, and test suites within the TestLink system. It handles user authentication checks, project validation, access rights, URL construction with parameters, and cookie management for linking and session management. The script provides both outer and inner frame rendering depending on the request context, and includes functions to process various items and build session cookies.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Represents a test project with methods to retrieve project data by prefix and manage session project context.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: Handles operations related to test cases, such as retrieving internal IDs.

classes.name: requirement_mgr
classes.description: Manages requirement data, providing access to requirements by documentation ID, version, and project.

classes.name: requirement_spec_mgr
classes.description: Manages requirement specifications, allowing retrieval based on document ID.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: Provides functionality to retrieve the hierarchical path of requirement or test suite items.

methods.name: checkTestProject
methods.description: Checks whether a user has the rights to view a specific test project item.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and parses request parameters from $_GET for processing the link action.

methods.name: buildLink
methods.description: Constructs a URL with encoded query parameters based on given arguments.

methods.name: process_testcase
methods.description: Generates a link to a specific test case, setting a session cookie for it.

methods.name: process_req
methods.description: Creates a URL to view a specific requirement, handling version validation and cookies.

methods.name: process_reqspec
methods.description: Creates a URL for a requirement specification document, managing cookies.

methods.name: buildCookie
methods.description: Constructs a cookie object containing the path and value based on the item hierarchy.

methods.name: process_testsuite
methods.description: Builds a link to a test suite and manages associated cookies.
